completion_requirements: A completed student annotation must satisfy: acceptable_labels non-empty, active_time_seconds >= 0, rule_difficulty in easy/moderate/hard, recognized_from_prior_work in true/false/unsure.
description: Template structure for student annotation output records (STUDENT_R1). Do NOT fill with synthetic data.

field_specifications.annotation_id: Must match one of the 350 frozen challenge IDs (ANN_B2_001 through ANN_B2_350).
field_specifications.primary_label: Canonical intent class name or null for irreducible semantic ambiguity.
field_specifications.acceptable_labels: Non-empty array of valid canonical intent classes under the taxonomy.
field_specifications.clarification_required: Boolean flag indicating whether query needs clarification or missing slot information.
field_specifications.clarification_reasons: Array of reasons from ['intent_ambiguity', 'missing_slot', 'multiple_goals', 'uninterpretable']. Must be empty if clarification_required is false.
field_specifications.active_time_seconds: Non-negative numeric value recording active annotation time in seconds.
